subject: Dedicated Cluster Quote: isolation uplift, KMS options & throughput SLAs
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Single-tenant Dedicated cluster — initial requirements

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the intro last week. Attaching a short requirements doc (Finova_dedicated_req_09012025.pdf). We are evaluating a single-tenant Dedicated deployment to host our customer-facing inference workloads. High level:~
- Peak throughput target ~120k tokens/sec (aggregate), steady-state ~60k tokens/sec.
- Expected 95th percentile latency target < 120ms for 2k-token prompts.
- Hard requirement: EU data residency and separate tenancy (no co-tenancy with other customers).
- Compliance: SOC 2, audit logs retained 2 years, and customer-managed keys (BYOK) preferred.
- Initial term: 12-month reserved commit; possibility to expand after Q2.

Please send an initial quote with the price uplift for single-tenant isolation + KMS/BYOK add-on and any recommended reserved commit sizing. Also include whether you can provide throughput SLAs and how overage/credits are handled.

Alex
Procurement
Finova Systems

Attachment: Finova_dedicated_req_09012025.pdf (pdf)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-tenant Dedicated cluster — initial requirements

Alex — thanks, got the requirements and appreciated the clarity. High level summary and next steps below.

Summary of options we recommend:
1) Shared Dedicated (default) — lower base price, multi-tenant GPU pools (not suitable for your isolation ask).
2) Single-tenant Dedicated (isolated GPU pool) — provides physical isolation, dedicated scheduling, and separate tenant network. Typical uplift is applied to cover capacity reservation and operational segregation.
3) Single-tenant + Compliance Pack — adds hardened audit logging (immutable logs, 24/7 retention replication), KMS BYOK connector, and extended retention (2y) for logs.

Initial pricing guidance (ballpark):
- Reserved commit sizing: for your throughput we recommend a 48-GPU pool (A100-class equivalent) with continuous batching configuration targeting 60k steady tokens/sec and burst capacity to 120k.
- Base price for Dedicated pool (monthly): $X (we'll provide exact numbers in quote).
- Isolation uplift: we typically apply a premium for single-tenant isolation and hardened ops; starting point is 20% on top of the base Dedicated rate (this covers provisioning overhead, capacity headroom, and isolation controls).
- KMS/BYOK: once-off integration + monthly key management fee (details below).
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime for Reserved pools; throughput SLOs tied to commit size. We include a credit policy for downtime and sustained throughput shortfalls.

Questions for you before we produce a formal quote:
- Do you expect a steady pattern (predictable daily load) or spiky multi-region bursts?
- Any additional compliance certifications beyond SOC2 (e.g., PCI, ISO27001)?
- Is Finova willing to consider a 24-month commit for deeper discounting?

I'll attach a first draft quote (rwdw_draft_quote_v1.pdf) after you confirm the above. Looping in Neha for pricing detail and Marcus for legal/compliance notes.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-tenant Dedicated cluster — initial requirements

Alex — I ran the sizing and pricing scenarios. Two quick configurations that meet the numbers: 

Option A (Conservative steady-state):
- 48 GPUs reserved, optimized batching: target steady 60k tokens/sec, burst buffer to 110k.
- Monthly committed spend: $385,000 (base Dedicated rate).
- Isolation uplift: +20% -> $462,000/month.
- Compliance Pack (audit logging 2y + KMS connector): one-time $15k integration + $6,500/month.
- Recommended discount: 8% for a 12-month prepay; 14% for 24-month prepay.

Option B (Burst-optimized):
- 56 GPUs reserved, higher headroom for bursts to 120k with lower latency variance.
- Monthly committed spend: $450,000 (base).
- Isolation uplift: +20% -> $540,000/month.
- Compliance Pack: same as above.

Notes on SLAs/credits:
- Throughput SLA is tied to committed GPUs. If average monthly throughput falls below 95% of target for >=72 hours, we provide pro-rated credit up to 20% of that month's committed charge.
- For short interruptions we offer uptime credits per the SLA schedule.

I'll attach the detailed line-item quote and a simple amortization schedule. We can flex the isolation uplift if procurement pushes back — need guidance from Legal on risk appetite.

— Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: S. Jacobs <s.jacobs@finova.com>

Rishi/Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few comments from finance/procurement: 

1) The isolation uplift at 20% feels high given our expected utilization; can you provide a breakdown of what is driving that premium (infrastructure vs ops vs compliance)?
2) We'd prefer the Compliance Pack's KMS to be priced as a predictable monthly fee rather than a large integration charge. Can you convert the $15k one-time to a 12-month amortized fee?
3) We expect to sign a 12-month commit initially. What's the best you can do on total TCV if we commit to $4.5M upfront?

Also: how do you handle key custody for BYOK — will Finova's key ever transit Redwood-managed hardware? We need assurance on key isolation.

Regards,
S. Jacobs
VP Finance, Finova Systems
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: S. Jacobs <s.jacobs@finova.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-tenant Dedicated cluster — initial requirements

S. Jacobs — appreciate the specific asks. Quick clarifications from Legal/Platform: 

1) Isolation uplift breakdown (typical):
   - Capacity headroom & reserved scheduling: ~9%
   - Operational segregation (separate runbooks, dedicated on-call, deployment rings): ~6%
   - Enhanced monitoring & immutable audit store with replication: ~3%
   = total ~18–20% depending on data egress/residency work.

2) KMS/BYOK handling:
   - We support a BYOK flow where customer keys are stored exclusively in your KMS (we integrate via KMIP/KMS connectors). Redwood never persists plaintext keys. Key material can be kept off our control plane; we maintain a cryptographic handshake for tokenization. The integration involves work on both sides; we can amortize our integration fee across 12 months as requested.

3) Commercial concession proposal:
   - For a 12-month upfront commit of $4.5M we can reduce the isolation uplift from 20% -> 15% and apply a 10% prepay discount on base commit. Compliance Pack integration fee amortized monthly.
   - Final configuration example (Option A, adjusted):
     * Base monthly after 10% prepay discount: $346,500
     * Isolation uplift +15% -> $398,475/month
     * Compliance Pack (amortized): $1,250/month (instead of $15k up-front) + $6,500/month ongoing

If that sounds reasonable we'll produce a redlined quote (rwdw_draft_quote_v3.pdf) reflecting final T&Cs, SLA credits, and KMS flow language.

— Marcus Lin
VP Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
